title: REQ · Event log renders game history in its own scrolling region and App feeds real state
summary: Event log lists state.history; App passes live game state into the rebuilt panel.
description: Context: history renders as a bare ol. Desired behavior: a framed Event log region showing history entries in order (newest visible via scroll) with a max-height scroll, and App continues to pass game.state.history, inventory and choose from useGame with no leftover old styling. Expected result: log reflects game state changes after choices.
acceptance_criteria: Given history ['a','b'], then the Story history list shows a then b inside an sf-frame-plaque region.
Given empty history, then the log shows the text 'Nothing has happened yet'.
Given App rendered after Begin, then StoryPanel receives the game state's history, inventory and choose and old border-amber/bg-stone-900 classes are gone.
technical_constraints: Real game state only; no mocked data.
definition_of_done: Log reads from state; no legacy styling
